launch.threads: one thread per tile cell c < nc; element (i,j) of every table array is word c + (i-ims)*nc + (j-jms)*nc*(ime-ims+1)

args.name: ptrs
args.layout: binder ruc_layout.rs ICE_TSK (13 fields, no optional flags)

roles.tsk_sea: out, overwrite on its..ite x jts..jte
roles.tsk_ice: out, overwrite on its..ite x jts..jte

args.name: tables
args.inactive_reason: RUC constant tables; drivers_correct_tsk_over_seaice reads none

args.name: work
args.inactive_reason: arena scratch; drivers_correct_tsk_over_seaice takes no arena rows (mark/restore only)

linearisation.tsk_ice: d = (ice && (L51 fired || L52 fired)) ? 0 : d_tsk   [L51: xice < 0.2 && tsk < 253.15; L52: xice < 0.1 && tsk_ice(after L51) < 263.15]
linearisation.adjoint: b_tsk += (L51||L52 ? 0 : b_tsk_ice) + (sea clamp ? 0 : b_tsk_sea); b_tsk_sea = b_tsk_ice = 0

branches.inactive_reason: outputs are piecewise constant in xice and xice_thresh

branches.predicate: i in its..ite, j in jts..jte

limiters.treatment: frozen coefficient from the trajectory: derivative 1 if tsk > 271.4 else 0 (tie -> the constant, 0)
frozen coefficient from the trajectory: derivative 0 where it fires, else 1 (strict compare: tie passes)
frozen coefficient from the trajectory, evaluated on the L51 result: derivative 0 where it fires

frozen_coefficients: three clamps (L47, L51, L52) and the ice predicate (L45), each frozen on the trajectory primal tsk, xice, xice_thresh (never written by the forward)
precision: float32; TL is copies and zeros only (exact); AD adds with __fadd_rn; --fmad=false --ftz=false

range_hazards.hazard: derivative switch: tsk_sea jumps from slope 1 to 0 at tsk = 271.4 over ice; a perturbation larger than the margin |tsk - 271.4| crosses it (Taylor sees the kink)
derivative switch at 253.15 K on thin ice
derivative switch at 263.15 K on very thin ice
a cell changing ice state switches all three clamps on or off; xice is not differentiated (zero derivative), a jump in tsk_sea of max(0, 271.4 - tsk) is not seen by the TL

alias: outputs disjoint from inputs and from each other (checked per launch, slot 1); primal reads through the live table are the pre-launch values because the forward never writes tsk, xice or xice_thresh

inactive_slots.9: xice: switch predicate only (piecewise-constant output, zero derivative)
